svg.title: dsh-table-ingest structure: one file, ranked candidates, a header decision, and two honest exits
svg.desc: A docx with two same-header tables is read by the format readers. The centre scoreboard ranks every candidate table; a selection guard sends the ambiguous case straight down to the amber ok:false door, which returns candidates[] and error instead of guessing. A clear winner moves right into header detection over the first six rows, then down into the green ok:true door with tableJson, preview and warnings. Both doors are returns of ingestToTable.
svg.text: 5 formats → 3 readers → ranked candidates → header → tableJson · when unsure, it says so
same header across a page break → merged first
top1 − top2 < 20 and no expectedColumns hit → no choice
else medium / low · low = a human should look
when no single table is certain → ok:false
returns the candidates and the reason; never fabricates a table
preview: is this the table you meant?
